composition.central_negative_space: preserve a clean dark field behind the mark; energy vectors point inward without diffuse glow

forge_plate.role: smaller second line; keep clearly subordinate

sweep.role: brief diagonal crystal accent using seven shared instances of the 8x8 particle sprite

background.density: medium at edges, low under logo
background.forbidden: blurred glow, noisy sparkle fill across center, lower corners overpowering mark
background.status: WIP uses 610 unique tiles; the 20-40 tile target remains a future re-authoring/optimization gate.

asset_roles.rendering: one original authored plate per word; no runtime font or code-drawn glyphs
same visual material family as SGDK, subordinate scale and contrast

asset_roles.translation_note: The concept has partial alpha and 36,991 RGBA values; it is not an indexed 8x8 sprite strip. Re-author clusters on native grid.

asset_roles.note: Seven shared 8x8 instances use y=76..124 in 8px steps; x starts at -16 and moves 10px/frame.

palette_roles.index0: Transparent for imported plates and sprites.
palette_roles.PAL0: Dark navy and restrained cobalt environment for BG_B.
palette_roles.PAL1: SGDK wordmark, ice face, cobalt outline and pale cyan highlights.
palette_roles.PAL2: FORGE wordmark in the same material family at subordinate hierarchy.
palette_roles.PAL3: Crystal particles and sweep; brief white replay hint after the lab preview fade.
palette_roles.hardware_constraints: Maximum 15 visible colors per 4bpp palette; every color on the 9-bit VDP grid. Exact index-role mapping remains provisional.

motion_model.energy_births: Distributed across frames 24-83; no 8-at-once pileup at center.
motion_model.radial_motion: 16 directions, 8.8 fixed-point vectors; particles start at radius 8px, expand to 88px, turn inward, then converge during frames 84-119.
motion_model.hold_fade: Frames 210-239 fade the complete lockup. At frame 240 the isolated lab preview stops audio, clears BG_A, writes A: REPLAY SPLASH V3 and waits for A; clean capture of that prompt remains pending.

development_scope.allowed: WIP assets and isolated laboratory preview for future review and improvement
development_scope.not_approved: final artwork, final musical quality, template promotion, FORJA V2 archive, or consumer-project migration

approval_checks: SGDK and FORGE spell exactly and remain distinct at native 320x224.
SGDK is the dominant mark; FORGE reads as its signature line.
The energy reads as separate expansion and convergence beats, not a continuous glow.
The BG_B edges frame the mark without competing with it in grayscale.
Each final asset is native 8x8 clustered, indexed, has index 0 role declared, and has no partial alpha.
Final particle choreography is re-measured from actual anchors and final sprite cells.
Inspect the sweep during motion, not only a still frame, and confirm it leaves SGDK/FORGE readable.
Verify the A: REPLAY SPLASH V3 hold screen with a clean BlastEm capture and replay the scene twice.
Review the 610-tile backdrop against the stated 20-40 tile art vocabulary target before any final asset approval.
Bind final visual and audio judgment to the exact ROM and asset hashes; keep those approvals separate.

runtime_preview.emulator: local pinned BlastEm 1.0.0; canonical capture route not sealed
